teaser: Hem Pant's governance as code and Sondera's policy-as-code paper, joined: who holds each control, and six controls we tried to break.
core_idea: Governance as code and autoformalized policy-as-code both move the policy from text to something that runs and can be tested; for agents one column has to be added, who holds each control, because only a control held from above the agent (a Boundary) can be proven not to be switched off, and proof means a deliberate violation refused, as six of our own controls show.
